The checkout card

Every item is one card, start to finish.

No group chats, no IOUs on a whiteboard. The card tracks the item from the moment it's listed to the moment it's back on the shelf.

Listed

Put it on the board

Snap a photo, set a daily price and a deposit, and pin your pickup spot. Your calculator can pay for itself between exams.

Claimed

Offer, accept, meet up

Borrowers send an offer or pay the listed rate. The deposit is held by Mazingo the moment it's accepted — no cash changes hands.

Returned

Check it back in

Borrower scans the card to check the item back in, the deposit releases automatically, and both sides rate the handoff.

Why bother

Reputation you actually build

  • 🔥

    Streaks reward reliability

    Every on-time return adds a day to your streak. Break it, and your next deposit hold goes up slightly — no drama, just math.

  • 🏅

    Badges unlock lower fees

    Hit Five‑Star Lender and Mazingo's cut on your listings drops from 8% to 5%. Trust is worth something here.

  • 🏫

    Campus leaderboard

    See which floor lends the most. HTW's dorm block has been undefeated for three semesters running.

01

Deposits held, not guessed at

Mazingo holds the agreed deposit from the moment an offer's accepted until check‑in. Nobody's Venmo-ing a stranger.

02

One small fee, shown upfront

A transaction fee is added at checkout — never buried. Lenders see it before they set a price, borrowers see it before they pay.

03

Every handoff, on the record

Pickup and return are both logged in the app, with photos if either side wants them. Disputes get resolved against that record.
